description: A min-width keeps a shrinking flex item from going below it, and a min-width larger than max-width wins over it.

florui.css: .row { display: flex; width: 200px; height: 40px; } .a { width: 150px; min-width: 120px; background-color: #2f7d6c; } .b { width: 150px; background-color: #808080; } .c { max-width: 50px; min-width: 80px; height: 20px; background-color: #c0392b; }
